race.comment: PHOENIX FLAMING (5) comes off a solid performance from the back in a 3YO Open race, beaten 2L. That was Saturday company and he was steadied, so the effort reads well for a maiden of this standard. Ticks plenty of boxes and can land the knockout blow this time around. SPECIAL BLEND (12) is the key debutante, having won an easy Lark Hill trial by 2.49 lengths and she has William Pike aboard for a stable with a solid debut record. Looks to have some ability on what we saw from her latest trial and she can make an immediate impact. UNIMANDO (2) has already placed twice from four starts and was beaten only a neck first-up at Belmont. Can build on that effort and feature with a touch of luck. PHOTOSYNTHESIS (7) resumed with a head defeat at Bunbury in a strong return performance. Wouldn't surprise to see her right in the finish. ARNO RIVER (3) is better than he showed last time out and can be thereabouts.
